items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: The trio with Joe Farrell and Jimmy Garrison, I got to hear that a bunch of times.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. I can understand that. I was just absolutely –you know it’s different if you’re in a more spacious venue but when you see – well anyway seeing Elvin, because I was trying to imagine like I’d only heard rock drumming, you know. And how – it sounds like

two guys and how is he doing that. And I just sat there with my jaw on the floor. I mean Elvin ruined me for hearing drummers. Any other drummer after that seemed like yeah, this guy’s pretty good but he ain’t Elvin. You know? And I went to hear Elvin as many times as I could after that. The trio with Joe Farrell and Jimmy Garrison, I got to hear that a bunch of times. And I heard Roland Kirk a whole bunch of times too at the Vanguard. Both of them.
